name: Gore Magala
description: (Tag:evolving)(Tag:flying)(Tag:massive-size)(Tag:poison)Gore Magala is a Demi Elder Dragon with six limbs and considerable strength. Blind, it senses via heat and scattered pollen-like scales that pollute the air. This pollen carries the Frenzy Virus, driving bestial beings berserk and blocking natural healing in humanoids for a time; fed enough high-quality prey, it metamorphoses into Shagaru Magala after some time.
